name: Modern Bar
description:
Tron-style theme for the top panel: neon circuit colors on a flat deep-black background, in seven selectable palettes (blue, white, gold, orange, red, teal, violet). Quick Settings and the calendar dropdown are recolored to match — colors only, no layout changes, and it can be toggled off.

Adds a compact metrics cluster on the left, each with a click-open detail dropdown: CPU load, workday progress, weather, and optional Claude and Codex account usage.

Network access: weather and location search use the Open-Meteo API (no account or API key; only coordinates are sent). The Claude and Codex usage metrics are opt-in and off by default. When enabled, each reads the login its CLI already stores locally and sends it only to that provider's own usage endpoint. Credential files are not opened and no request is made while the corresponding metric is off. No other data leaves the machine.
